description:
> *Generated by AI from docs/research/c-verification-macos.md.*

One entry point (e.g. mix defk.verify [asan|ubsan|valgrind|fuzz|cbmc|leaks]) so each check runs as its own task, plus a release alias/step that runs the release set. Not added to mix ci. Mac: ASan via OTP's asan emulator or DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES with +Mea min (see research note §1); Linux: Valgrind container. Documents how to run each in docs/guides/testing.md.

comments.text: From defk-30c.3: the check-only 'mix defk.examples' (compile + agreement of every example outside mix test, plus fuzzy_search's 7 tests; no timing, works on a loaded machine; DEFK_SANITIZE allowed) is a candidate for the release set. Measured wall time 792 s (13 min) on a loaded host (load 4-7, provisional; deps and C build cache warm; a cold run with Mix.install deps adds ~9 min for argon2). Biggest: cdcl_sat 340 s, keccak 129 s, cdcl_sat_per_call 76 s, hash_chain 65 s. Task layout: dev/mix/tasks/ (put mix defk.verify there).

title: mix task to run the verification checks on demand, and a release alias that runs them
